artworks.title: Portrait of a Leatherworker
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a high wooden stool. He is turned slightly to face the front, with facial features displaying a sideburn and a mustache. He has dark, slightly unkempt hair and is dressed in a plaid suit with a light-colored shirt underneath. The man is working with his hands on an object in front of him, appearing to be a camera or a photographic device mounted on a wooden stand. The background is plain with subtle textures, suggesting an indoor setting, possibly a studio. The wooden floor beneath him has a faint grid pattern.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Bootmaker
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated on a chair, facing the camera with a neutral expression. He has a mustache, medium-length hair, and is wearing a patterned shirt and an apron. He is holding a boot in his hands, with another boot placed on the floor beside him. The background shows a plain wall and patterned flooring.

artworks.title: Head of a Youth and a Man with a Moustache
artworks.description: The image depicts the head of a person with their eyes closed, facing slightly downward. The facial features include a composed expression with soft shading suggesting light falling on the face. The hair is dark, straight, and slightly tousled, framing the face. Pencil sketch textures create a soft background ambiance. The shoulders of the person blend into the background sketch lines. The background is an unfinished, light sketch without specific objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Study for the Renovation of a Law Classroom at the Sorbonne
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David Schaff in memory of Margot Greer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural floor plan showing seating arrangements, possibly for an auditorium or lecture hall. It includes a central focal point, angled seating sections, annotations in French, a circular staircase area, and structural diagrams. The drawing is detailed and utilizes different colors to distinguish various sections. The technical style indicates its purpose as a construction or renovation blueprint.

artworks.title: Séquestré
artworks.medium: pen and ink  with watercolor on board with a mounted photomechanical illustration
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nicholas Martin in memory of his parents, Vernon Paul and Jean Webster Martin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two connected scenes with accompanying text. The upper scene depicts an interior with two figures interacting, potentially suggesting a stage or performance. The lower scene shows a domestic setting with figures by a writing desk and sitting, with open windows framing a scene outside. The styles employ light satire with an etched or sketched quality. The additional section titled "Séquêstre" includes a solitary figure by a window, paired with handwritten text in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Hein! Pas très blancs tes dessous... (Hmm! Your Underwear Isn't Very White)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on board with a mounted photomechanical illustration
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nicholas Martin in memory of his parents, Vernon Paul and Jean Webster Martin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical street scene. The scene depicts a lively comedic interaction, likely within a theatrical context, with exaggerated expressions and gestures typical of such performances. A central figure is gesturing dramatically, surrounded by others. The characters' attire and postures suggest a historical setting. The drawing includes a humorous dialogue in French.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Iphigenia
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of black chalk, squared for transfer, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting multiple figures, including celestial beings and individuals in classical attire. The scene is intricately sketched with flowing lines, showing motion among terrestrial and aerial figures. The earthly characters seem engaged in a dramatic moment, while two ethereal figures above hint at a narrative, possibly of a divine or mythological nature. Circles grid the surface, alluding to composition guidelines, and sepia tones convey a timeworn feel. The drawing is lively and dynamic, capturing energy and movement in the arrangement and interaction of the figures.

artworks.title: Lagrime (Tears)
artworks.medium: etching [proof] with monotype wiping on Chinese paper mounted on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 27 × 28.9 cm (10 5/8 × 11 3/8 in.)
sheet (both Chinese paper and wove paper mount): 32.4 × 33.1 cm (12 3/4 × 13 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene featuring stairs and a carved figure. It is rendered in a dark, monochromatic palette. The image shows an ascending staircase leading to an intricately designed building facade adorned with architectural elements, and a carved figure or statue atop the structure. The foreground is filled with dense shadowing, emphasizing the textures of the stone steps and walls. The composition leads the eye upwards, towards a lighter sky background. The interplay of light and shadow in the sketch adds tension to the scene, evoking a sense of intrigue and timelessness.

artworks.title: John Ashworth, Edmund Ashworth, Edmund Ashworth, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing closely together. The man on the left has a full beard and wears a top hat, with his left hand partially visible. The middle man wears a top hat and a dark suit with a white shirt and a cravat. The man on the right is wearing a top hat, a dark overcoat, light-colored trousers, and gaiters. He is holding an object resembling an early camera. They stand against a backdrop with an indistinct building in the distance, with the photograph framed in a decorative red and gold border.

artworks.title: Isabel, Charlotte, Rebecca, and Charlotte Anne Ashworth
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals, from the waist up. An elderly woman is seated with her hands clasped, while three young women stand behind her. The elderly woman wears a light bonnet and shawl. The young women have dark hair styled to reveal their ears, wearing similar plaid dresses with high collars. The women have different facial expressions. The photograph is in an ornate wooden frame with a decorative matte. The background is plain, focusing attention on the individuals.

artworks.title: Edmund Ashworth Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the waist up. He has short, dark hair and styled sideburns. He is wearing a dark suit jacket, waistcoat, and a cravat. His left arm is resting on a table with a patterned cloth, and his right hand is on his thigh. The man's gaze is directed towards the camera, and he has a neutral expression. A watch chain hangs from his waistcoat. The image is framed in gold within a red frame, with a plain, neutral background typical of vintage photographs.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. She is seated, with one arm resting on the back of a wooden chair and the other hand placed on an ornately patterned tablecloth. The woman has a calm expression with a slight smile. Her hair is styled in a neat, middle-parted manner around her ears. She is wearing a long-sleeved, dark dress with pleated details on the bodice and a full skirt. The woman has a bracelet on her visible wrist. The background is plain and dark, and the photo is framed in a rectangular mat with a red velvet border and gold edging.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman's upper body. She sits upright in a frontal position, with a serious expression. She wears a dark dress with a high neckline and an ornate shawl. Her hands rest in her lap, holding a small object. She also wears a lace collar and long gloves. The background is a simple, neutral backdrop with aging effects, like an old photograph. The image is set within a decorative frame with a red velvet border.

artworks.title: Edmund Ashworth Jr.
artworks.description: The image portrays the upper body of a young person in a formal pose. The individual has a neutral expression on their face and short, neatly combed hair. They are wearing a dark-colored jacket over a white shirt with a high collar and a patterned vest underneath. The portrait is set in a red velvet-lined case with a gold border. The background of the image is plain and indistinct.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person seated, facing slightly to the left. The person has a straight posture, with both hands resting on their lap. Their facial features include a neutral expression, with light-colored eyes, a straight nose, and a slightly parted mouth. They have curly hair, partially visible beneath a soft, rounded cap. They are dressed in formal clothing, consisting of a dark coat and a white shirt, accented with a large, dark bow tie around the collar. A chain is draped across the chest. The background is plain, and the image is bordered with an ornate, gold-colored frame inside a velvet-lined case.

artworks.title: Rebecca Ashworth
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in a formal pose with her hands on her lap. She has delicate facial features, styled back hair with a hairpiece, and is wearing an off-the-shoulder dress with lace details, a fabric bow, a necklace, and bracelets. The background includes a table with a cloth and a book, and a blurred backdrop. The image is framed with a gold mat and a red velvet border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, seated with his right elbow resting slightly on his knee. His head is tilted slightly to the side. The man has a receding hairline with short-cropped hair and a full beard. He is dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt underneath and a bow tie, holding a straw hat in his lap. The background shows a blurred interior with potted flowers by a window or ledge. The image is bordered with an ornate gold frame.

artworks.title: Mark Ashworth
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bust view. He is seated and facing slightly to the right with his right elbow resting on a surface and head supported by his hand. He has a neutral facial expression, short dark hair, a dark suit with a high collar, a striped shirt, a bow tie, and a watch chain visible across his vest. The surface has a patterned texture and the background is plain with a decorative frame featuring a red velvet border and gold edges.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image features a man seated from the waist up. He is slightly turned to the side, facing forward with his gaze towards the camera. The man has distinct facial features, clean-shaven with a small patch of facial hair below his lower lip. His hair is styled with a middle part and combed back on the sides. He is dressed in a dark suit with a waistcoat and white shirt, along with a bowtie. A chain attached to his waistcoat indicates a pocket watch. Leaning on a table with a patterned cloth, he has an open book in front of him. The background is plain, and the photograph is framed in gold with floral patterns.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman and Baby
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and an infant, both visible from the waist up. The woman is seated, holding the infant in her lap, and both are looking slightly off to the side. The woman has shoulder-length dark, curly hair that is parted in the middle. She wears a dark dress with a white collar, a brooch at the center, and a watch chain pinned at her shoulder. She also wears earrings and a bracelet. The infant is dressed in a white christening gown with lace patterns and a bonnet. The child looks cozy in the woman's arms. The background is plain and dark to highlight the subjects. The image is in an ornate frame with a gold-tone inner edge and a velvet-lined border, typical of 19th-century portrait displays.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and Woman
artworks.description: The image shows an older couple sitting next to each other. The man is seated on the left, wearing a dark suit with a vest, white shirt, and a bow tie. His hair is short and combed back, and he has a calm expression. The woman sits on the right, facing the camera. She has dark hair mostly covered by a lace bonnet with a large ruffle framing her face. She has a composed expression and is wearing a dark dress with long sleeves and a brooch fastened at the collar. Both are seated on simple upholstered chairs against a plain backdrop. The photograph is encased within an ornate gold frame, bordered by a red fabric mat.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a seated couple captured in a half-body portrait. The man on the left has short, gray hair, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. He wears a black suit with a vest and a bow tie. The woman on the right has medium-length gray hair with a decorative headpiece and a composed look. She wears a dark dress with a light blue shawl, a necklace, and holds her hands together in her lap. The background is a simple dark backdrop. The photograph is in an ornate, gold-trimmed frame with intricate designs, set against a red velvet mat.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a half-length sitting portrait. The individual is seated, slightly turned to the side. Their facial features are slightly visible, possibly due to photo quality. They have short or closely cropped hair, and wear clothing with a pattern and a white collar. Their right hand rests on their lap with a white cuff visible. The image has a vintage frame with a gold and red border. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with her upper body visible. She is posed with her elbow resting on a table draped with a patterned cloth, her hand touching her face, and adorned with jewelry on her fingers. Her facial features are distinct, with a broad forehead and soft expression, accentuated by her hair parted in the middle and styled smoothly to frame her face. She is dressed in a dark gown with a high neckline, white lace collar, cuffs of matching lace, and a long chain necklace. The background is plain, and the image is presented in an oval frame with a gold-colored border.
